sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:24

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:24:1
items.html:
And this is the secret of “a woman of valor is the crown of her husband,” who in the future will be greater than the sun, and this is the secret of “she became the head of the corner”: This refers to the discernment of Malchut that is concealed in the Rosh [head] of Atik Yomin, which is not revealed in her own self, except after the entry of all the surrounding lights of Atzilut, as inner lights, into her nine lower ones, which are the nine Sefirot of Rosh and Guf [body] of AA, together with his four garments, which are AVI and ZON. And after this, the Malchut that is concealed in the Rosh of Atik is revealed, in the secret of the verse, “she became the head of the corner,” for then all see her merit, how she stands at the head of the corner, which is the first Rosh, and all the worlds of ABYA are her offspring.
And this is what he says, “the nine Sefirot are of AA, and the supernal Rosh that is not known, above them all, is the phase of Atik.” That is, as has been explained, AA and all his four garments, AVI and ZON, are regarded as the expansion of her nine lower Sefirot, and she is Keter to them, as above.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:24:2
items.html: The Malchut of the upper world itself becomes the phase of the Atik of the world below it: For all the Sefirot of the lower one are bestowed upon from the upper one by way of a screen, so that they are greatly diminished by the screen through which they pass — except for the Malchut of the upper one, which does not pass by way of the screen, but breaches the screen and passes over to the lower one, as written above in the words of the ARI (page 126, item 34; and see Inner Light there, the passage beginning “Breaching”).
